blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Robinsons Land Corp. (RLC) will transfer Robinsons Manila to RL Commercial REIT Inc. (RCR) in a P20.16-billion property-for-share swap, adding nearly 104,000 square meters (sq m) of gross leasable area to the REIT’s portfolio. The boards of both companies approved the proposed transaction at separate special meetings on Nov. 20. READ: Retail resurgence prompts RCR expansion The deal covers Robinsons Manila, which has a gross leasable area of 103,984.12 sq m.
